title: Counting Complimentary Basic Work per Purchase Record — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
Marlowe & Finch Alterations counts two allowances in this clause: complimentary basic work, and Finch Circle alteration credit.

## 1. Complimentary basic work counted per purchase record

> Complimentary basic work is counted per purchase record across all tickets: the complimentary operations granted on every ticket that names the same purchase record never exceed the class's maximum complimentary operations in total, so a garment brought back on a second ticket receives only what remains of that allowance.

**Status.** For a complimentary waiver that customer care books on a ticket, this per-purchase counting is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current complimentary-work terms, under which the allowance for such a waiver is counted on the ticket and any further qualifying operation on that ticket stays chargeable. For any other complimentary waiver the per-purchase count above still stands.

Where the per-purchase count stands, it works as follows (hypothetical figures): with a class maximum of 3 and 2 complimentary operations already granted on an earlier ticket naming the same purchase record, a second ticket naming that purchase record can receive at most 1 more.

## 2. Finch Circle alteration credit counted per membership

This clause remains in force: Finch Circle alteration credit is counted per membership and benefit year under the Finch Circle rules, not per ticket. Opening a second Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket does not create a second credit allowance; both tickets draw on the same membership's credit for the benefit year.

superseded_clauses: Complimentary basic work is counted per purchase record across all tickets: the complimentary operations granted on every ticket that names the same purchase_id (alteration_msr_complimentary_ops_on_purchase) never exceed the class's complimentary_max_operations in total, so a garment brought back on a second ticket receives only what remains of that allowance.
